snapshotModule.title: A softer last light
snapshotModule.description: You do not need to finish the whole room tonight. If you want the room to help you slow down more easily, start by adding one softer final layer of light near the bed.
snapshotModule.whyThisFitsBody: When a bedroom already feels visually light but still does not fully settle into rest, the missing piece is often not more decor. It is a softer last light that helps the room leave "still in use" mode.
snapshotModule.ctaSecondary: Find a softer light for this room
snapshotModule.footerNote: Not every room needs more things. But when a room is already quiet and still does not fully hold rest, the most useful next layer is often a better support signal, not more decoration.

fullReportModule.title: Make this shift easier
fullReportModule.description: Your room already has a calm base. The next step is not a major redesign, but the right support layer in the right place.

trustLayer.title: Why these were chosen
trustLayer.body: These supports are based on your room's current signals, not generic decor suggestions.

supports.name: Night Wind-Down Support
supports.oneLiner: A softer final layer that helps the room leave "still in use" mode.
supports.whyThisMattersBody: Your room may already feel calm and visually light, but that is not the same as feeling clearly held by night. A lower, softer light helps the room shift out of functional use and into a more settled end-of-day rhythm.
whatItHelpsShift: from still active to ready for rest
supports.bestFor: Rooms that feel calm, but still a little on at night.
supports.ctaSecondary: See what light fits this room

productExplanationCard.title: Why this helps your room
productExplanationCard.body: Your room already has enough light. What it needs is a softer final signal that helps the day end more clearly.
productExplanationCard.bestWhen: quiet, but still a little active at night.

supports.name: Bed Softening Layer
supports.oneLiner: A tactile support layer that makes the bed feel more complete and more ready to hold rest.
supports.whyThisMattersBody: Some bedrooms are not missing structure. They are missing a stronger sense that the bed is ready to receive rest. A soft layer helps the bed read as more settled without making the room feel heavier.
supports.bestFor: Rooms that feel clean, but not fully grounding.
supports.ctaSecondary: See soft layers for my room

productExplanationCard.title: Why this helps your room
productExplanationCard.body: Your bed zone may feel visually light, but not fully settled. This adds softness and completion without making the room heavier.

supports.name: Quiet Anchor Support
supports.oneLiner: A small bedside anchor that gives the night a place to land.
supports.whyThisMattersBody: A room can already be simple and still feel like it is missing a point of rest. A quiet anchor helps the eye and mind land somewhere steady, so the room feels less purely functional at night.
supports.bestFor: Rooms that feel simple, but missing a clear night-time landing point.

productExplanationCard.title: Why this helps your room
productExplanationCard.body: Your room does not need more decoration. It needs one small, stable object that helps the eye and mind land.
productExplanationCard.bestWhen: simple, but missing a point of rest.

kits.name: Wind-Down Kit
kits.tagline: Help the room know the day is ending.
kits.description: A small support set that helps the room leave daytime mode and move into a softer end-of-day rhythm.
kits.goodFor: Rooms that feel calm, but do not clearly shift into night.

kits.name: Rest Nest Kit
kits.tagline: Make the bed feel more ready to hold rest.
kits.description: A softening set for bed zones that feel functional, but not fully ready to receive rest.
kits.goodFor: Rooms where the bed is usable, but still feels thin or unfinished.

kits.name: Quiet Anchor Kit
kits.tagline: Give your night a place to land.
kits.description: A small bedside set that creates a stable visual and emotional landing point for the night.
kits.goodFor: Rooms that need a more intentional bedside ritual cue.
